_comment: Unlimited-OCR document-parsing registry entries. Merge into <app_data>/models/registry.json. Two entries, one per installed weight file, sharing a single F16 vision projector: the accuracy-to-speed slider moves between them. Both are cleared for NOTHING — permittedClassifications is deliberately empty, so the router will not send a document to either until an administrator reviews the model and grants classifications. That is the registry's safety property, not an oversight.
_projector: mmproj-Unlimited-OCR-F16-patched.gguf is required by BOTH entries and is never quantized. It is the upstream mmproj-Unlimited-OCR-F16.gguf with two metadata keys added: clip.vision.preproc_max_tiles=32 and clip.vision.preproc_min_tiles=2. Without them llama.cpp throws "Key not found" while loading the projector, the exception is never caught, and the process dies with STATUS_STACK_BUFFER_OVERRUN (0xC0000409) before logging anything. The values are taken from sabafallah/Unlimited-OCR-GGUF, the conversion by the author of the llama.cpp DeepSeek-OCR PR. Only the KV block changed; all 476 tensors are byte-identical. sha256 d80b9f5157c716051e851047838f6b3be42c420fab17a23f563c05db463a1dc0.
_integrity: The sha256 values are the upstream Hugging Face LFS oids for sahilchachra/Unlimited-OCR-GGUF, re-hashed on disk after download and matched exactly. registry::integrity::verify checks these before every load, so a swapped or truncated file fails loudly instead of producing quietly worse OCR.
_provenance: Base model baidu/Unlimited-OCR (MIT). The GGUF is a third-party conversion whose architecture string was rewritten to DeepseekOCRForCausalLM to reach llama.cpp's DeepSeek-OCR path; the source config declares UnlimitedOCRForCausalLM. Whether that rewrite is behaviourally sound on long documents is unverified on this build — see the Phase 0 gate.

models._comment: High tier. Slider stops 3-4 (Detailed, Maximum). The card recommends Q4_K_M as the default; independent llama.cpp testing found Q4_K_M loops on some prompts, so the accuracy tier sits above that line.
models.name: Unlimited-OCR (Q6_K)

models._comment: Fast tier. Slider stops 1-2 (Fastest, Fast). Only safe with the DRY sampler engaged, which ai_engine::ocr_profile attaches to every request — Baidu's reference implementation uses a no-repeat-ngram logit processor that llama.cpp does not have.
models.name: Unlimited-OCR (Q4_K_M)
